name: Ban Gioc Waterfall
kicker: Border cascade on the Quay Son
summary: Stand on the Vietnam bank of Ban Gioc and look across the wide cascade on the Quay Son. Sleep in Dam Thuy, or in Cao Bang city, so the falls are a morning. From the end of November to the beginning of April the water is very low, so come between 10:30 and 15:30. Skip a late arrival in those months. A bamboo raft toward the foot is optional. The gate fee is check on arrival.
timeNeeded: Same day as the cave and the pagoda
getThere: More than 80 km east of Cao Bang city. Drive time is check on arrival.
bestMonths: June to September for more water; October to April, or October to May, for drier travel
heroCaption: The cascade, the Quay Son, and the limestone at Ban Gioc

notice.title: Low water has a clock
notice.body: From the end of November to the beginning of April the water is very low. Come between 10:30 and 15:30. A late arrival in those months wastes the day.

body: Stand on the Vietnam bank and take in the width of the cascade. A bamboo raft can take you toward the foot. A cross-border scenic route runs at Ban Gioc–Detian. Whether you may cross is check on arrival.

The cascade is about 300 m wide and 35 m high, in three tiers. The main fall is also over 30 m. Fuller water runs from June to September. The drier months are October to April, and also October to May.

Do the cave and the pagoda on this day. Pac Bo is north and Phia Oac is west, so leave them for other days. The gate fee is check on arrival. A raft, if you take one, is separate, and that price is check on arrival too.

figures.caption: A bamboo raft on the river in front of the cascade
figures.alt: A covered bamboo raft on the Quay Son with Ban Gioc waterfall and limestone behind it

gettingThere: Ban Gioc is in Dam Thuy, on the eastern road. The way out of Cao Bang city is National Highway 3, then the valley. The falls are more than 80 km from the city centre. Drive minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Cao Bang city
legs.body: East by car or motorbike, more than 80 km. Drive minutes are check on arrival. A local bus to the falls is check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Hanoi
legs.body: About 340 km north by national highway. Sleep in Cao Bang city or in Dam Thuy. This is not a day return from the capital. Hours on the road are check on arrival.

hours: Check on arrival. From the end of November to the beginning of April, come between 10:30 and 15:30.
admissionNote: Check on arrival. A raft toward the foot is separate from the gate, and that price is check on arrival too.
